name: cavemio-code-input
title: Code input
description: The six boxes, done properly: digits rise in, a paste cascades, a wrong code shakes and clears, the right one becomes a pill with a check.

cavemio.accessibility:
- One real input with autocomplete="one-time-code" and the numeric keyboard sits over the boxes, so SMS autofill, paste, and screen readers see a normal text field with a label.
- The caret is always at the end; the boxes only show where you are.
- A polite status region announces "Checking the code", "That code didn’t work. Enter it again." and "Code verified"; the red ring always comes with that message.
- The countdown’s digits are hidden from assistive tech while ticking; the button announces itself when it’s ready.
- Installs Number roll, Status button and Text morph. With reduced motion nothing rises, shakes or sweeps; the states change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: – · Runs when every box is filled. Resolve or return true to accept; throw or return false to reject.

props.name: onResend
props.description: – · Shows the resend line; the countdown starts on mount and after each resend.

props.name: resendAfter
props.description: 30 · Seconds before a code can be resent.

props.name: groups
props.description: – · Split the boxes, e.g. [3, 3] puts a dash between two threes.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: – · Controlled or not; a full value set from outside is checked too.

props.name: alphanumeric
props.description: false · Letters as well as digits (shown upper case).

props.name: label
props.description: "Enter the 6-digit code" · The field’s label; it morphs through the states.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: – · Focus the first box on mount.

features.title: One real input underneath
features.description: It has autocomplete="one-time-code" and the numeric keyboard, so SMS autofill, paste and screen readers all work.

features.title: Paste and autofill cascade
features.description: A pasted code drops into the boxes one after another.

features.title: It checks on the last digit
features.description: onComplete runs when every box is full, and the input is read-only while it checks.

features.title: Wrong codes are clear
features.description: The row shakes, the boxes turn red, the label says so, and the boxes clear from the right.

features.title: The right code is a moment
features.description: The boxes melt into one pill with a check and the label reads “Verified”.

features.title: Resend with a countdown
features.description: “Resend in 0:28” rolls down, then becomes a Resend button that shows Sending and Sent.

states.title: typing
states.description: Each character rises 45% out of a 4px blur (300ms); a deleted one lifts away (200ms). The active box has a 1.5px ring and a blinking caret.

states.title: paste
states.description: Several characters arriving at once (paste, one-time-code autofill, or a value set from outside) cascade in 45ms apart.

states.title: checking
states.description: Once full, onComplete runs and the row carries a 1.4s sweep of light; the input is read-only.

states.title: wrong
states.description: The row shakes (±5px, 380ms), the boxes ring red and the label morphs to "That code didn’t work"; after 650ms the characters lift away right to left (30ms apart) and focus returns to the first box.

states.title: right
states.description: Nothing moves: the boxes lose their own rings and the dash fades (300ms) while one emerald ring closes around the row (500ms), which opens at its end for a check that draws itself, and the label morphs to "Verified".

states.title: resend
states.description: With onResend, "Resend in 0:28" counts down (seconds roll down), then crossfades to a Resend button (Status button): Sending, Sent, and the clock starts again.
